prefill.quotation-end: zooplankton, 148 genera of macroinvertebrates and 39 species of amphibians.
prefill.comment: The amphibian richness that enters the paper's biodiversity index, and the fish presence used as a model factor (Methods: "fish presence was determined using eDNA metabarcoding"), come from eDNA metabarcoding of pond water. The reads are public (ENA PRJNA1495761), so the detections can be re-derived independently. This chain re-derives them for the 29 ponds in Türkiye with LifeWatch ERIC's PEMA pipeline and an NCBI BLAST check, as a test of how far the species list depends on the bioinformatic pipeline and its reference database.

prefill.aida: The amphibian species living in a pond and the presence of fish can be identified from the DNA in its water.

prefill.label: Amphibian species and fish presence in PONDERFUL ponds identified by eDNA metabarcoding (Cuenca-Cambronero et al. 2026)
Independent re-analysis of the PONDERFUL eDNA reads of 29 ponds in Türkiye with PEMA and an NCBI BLAST check
prefill.scope: The eDNA detections of amphibians and fish in the 29 ponds sampled in Türkiye (six sites west of Ankara, May-June 2022): which amphibian taxa are found in each pond and whether fish are present. In scope: the list of taxa per pond, the number of ponds with fish, and the taxa the reference database misses. Out of scope: the other five countries, macrophytes, zooplankton and macroinvertebrates, the ecosystem functions and the biodiversity-multifunctionality models.
prefill.methodology: The 93 public runs of the 29 Turkish ponds (ENA PRJNA1495761, 12S vertebrate marker, paired-end Illumina, three runs per pond, six for two ponds) are downloaded with MD5 checks and processed with LifeWatch ERIC's PEMA v3.0.0 (Nextflow, rootless Podman): quality trimming, Swarm clustering into ASVs and taxonomy with the RDP classifier on PEMA's 12S_v200 reference (3,851 ASVs, 70.3 million reads). The most abundant ASV of each assigned taxon and the 10 most abundant unresolved ASVs (101 in all) are checked against NCBI core_nt with megablast; a BLAST hit replaces PEMA's label at 97% identity or more over 95% of the sequence. A taxon is present in a pond when its replicate runs together hold at least 10 reads and 0.01% of the pond's reads. Amphibians are grouped at the genus level that 12S resolves.
prefill.deviation: A different bioinformatic pipeline and reference database from the paper's (INBO eDNA laboratories; details in the paper's supplementary methods, not read); primers left in the reads; a fixed read threshold for presence; amphibians resolved to genus where 12S cannot separate species (Anatolian water frogs); only the Turkish ponds.
